Title: User navigates to Contact Us page and views details
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running via `streamlit run ui/app.py`
Steps: 1. Launch the app in a browser | 2. Locate the sidebar 'Navigation' radio | 3. Select 'Contact Us'
Expected Result: The Contact Us page loads and displays the title 'Contact Us', the name 'Radhika Yadgire', phone '1234567', and email 'radhika@gmail.com'

Title: Full navigation flow from Home to Contact Us and back
Preconditions: App is running and reachable at the local Streamlit URL
Steps: 1. Open the app (defaults to 'Home') | 2. Verify Home page content is shown | 3. Click 'Contact Us' in sidebar | 4. Verify contact details are shown | 5. Click 'Home' in sidebar again | 6. Verify Home page reappears
Expected Result: User can move between Home and Contact Us pages repeatedly without errors, and each page renders its own content correctly

Title: Rapidly toggling between pages does not corrupt displayed contact info
Steps: 1. Click 'Contact Us' | 2. Immediately click 'Home' | 3. Immediately click 'Contact Us' again | 4. Repeat 5 times in quick succession
Expected Result: Contact Us page always shows the exact same, unaltered details (Radhika Yadgire / 1234567 / radhika@gmail.com) with no stale or mixed content from the Home page

Title: Contact details match the values specified in JIRA ticket MT-2
Preconditions: App is running and Contact Us page is open
Steps: 1. Open Contact Us page | 2. Read the displayed Name field | 3. Read the displayed Phone field | 4. Read the displayed Email field
Test Data: Expected Name: Radhika Yadgire; Phone: 1234567; Email: radhika@gmail.com
Expected Result: All three displayed values exactly match the ticket-provided data with no typos or formatting issues

Title: Contact Us page renders correctly even when browser window is resized very small
Preconditions: App is running in a browser window resized to a narrow mobile-like width (e.g. 320px)
Steps: 1. Resize browser window to a very small width | 2. Open sidebar navigation | 3. Select 'Contact Us'
Expected Result: Page remains usable: sidebar collapses/expands as expected via Streamlit's responsive layout and contact text is still fully readable without being cut off or throwing a rendering error

Title: Application does not crash if requirements are missing streamlit
Steps: 1. Attempt to run `streamlit run ui/app.py` in an environment missing dependencies | 2. Observe command output
Expected Result: A clear 'streamlit: command not found' or ModuleNotFoundError is shown instructing the user to install dependencies from requirements.txt; app does not silently fail
